title: Doppler-free resonantly enhanced two-photon spectroscopy of np and nf Rydberg states in atomic cesium
method: Doppler-free resonantly enhanced two-photon spectroscopy (6s-5d-nf, 6s-5d-np) in thermionic diodes
uncertainty: per value in parentheses (estimated, incl. 3x standard error and drift)
caveats: the 18, 25, 33, 44 nP intervals (footnote a) are differences of absolute levels of Weber & Sansonetti (same data as weber1987), not independent
